messages:
maria: Heads up — e2e on main is red. Lots of failures in feature ingestion tests. Looks like mock-featurestore stopped responding (heartbeat silence). Anyone on call?

ci-bot: pipeline failed — job: e2e/main-4218 — https://ci.redwood/4218

noah: seeing same locally. Errors are connection timeouts to mock-featurestore: TCP 10.5.8.3:7001

ash: logs show repeated: `Heartbeat not received for 45s` from featurestore-mock, then `connection refused`

ash: ```
E feature-ingest-test: failed to connect to mock-featurestore
Caused by: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: connect timed out
mock-featurestore: last heartbeat 2026-03-17T12:10:42Z
```

sneha: @devops_john can you check the mock VM pool? maybe DNS cache stale after yesterday's infra patch

devops_john: pinging nodes. I see NXDOMAIN for featurestore.internal.ci on node ci-runner-4. Flushed kube-dns cache and restarted coredns. Will restart pod group: mock-featurestore-v2

noah: requeueing job 4218

ci-bot: job 4218 rerun started — job_id=4218.1

noah: first rerun -> still failing same errors on node ci-runner-3; stacktrace identical. Can we bisect to upstream commit? Last green: 2078898000 (yesterday)

sneha: quick check: are tests depending on startup ordering? Maybe the mock takes >10s to announce. We can add a 5s extra wait in the harness to stabilize while we fix infra

maria: prefer not to add waits that mask issues. Plan: (1) devops try stable restart, (2) noah bisects, (3) mark flaky if needed

devops_john: restarted mock-featurestore pods on all runners. Also bumped image to mock-featurestore:2026-03-16-hotfix on runners with older images.

ci-bot: job 4218.1 finished — FAILURE

noah: rerun 2 -> PASSED on ci-runner-7, FAILED on ci-runner-3. So it's node-specific. suspect ephemeral DNS or host-level network flakiness.

ash: I can add retry decorator for the specific external call with backoff in tests, short term, to reduce noise. Will open a tiny PR if you want this quick mitigation.

sneha: please open PR with label ci/flaky-hotfix if you do that. Keep it small and reversible.

maria: created INC-5292 tracking infra root cause and next steps: https://tickets.redwood/INC-5292

devops_john: I've cordoned ci-runner-3 and scheduled node reprovision. Will monitor job queue and report back in 30m.

noah: starting bisect from 2078890000 -> 2078900000, will stop if we see a clear green on reprovisioned nodes. Ping me on thread when requeues start.

maria: thanks all — if CI still noisy after reprovision we'll fallback to pinning e2e to reprovisioned image and drain older runners.

noah: will update this thread after bisect results or when node reprovision completes.
